# pbs_prune_job (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox Backup Server prune job, with the attributes of `pbs_prune_job`. Needs `Datastore.Audit` on the job's datastore.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_prune_job" "store1" {
  id = "daily-store1"
}

output "store1_daily_backups_kept" {
  # keep is null for a job that sets no retention option.
  value = coalesce(try(data.pbs_prune_job.store1.keep.daily, null), 0)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the job to read, such as `daily-store1`.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the job is disabled.
- `keep` (Attributes) Retention: how many backups of each kind the job keeps; null when the job sets no retention option, so that it keeps every backup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keep))
- `max_depth` (Number) How many levels of namespaces below `ns` the job prunes too; null for all of them.
- `ns` (String) Namespace the job prunes; null for the datastore's root namespace.
- `schedule` (String) When the job runs, as a PBS calendar event.
- `store` (String) Datastore the job prunes.

<a id="nestedatt--keep"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keep`

Read-Only:

- `daily` (Number) How many backups the job keeps that are the last backup of each of the most recent days; null when it keeps none for this reason.
- `hourly` (Number) How many backups the job keeps that are the last backup of each of the most recent hours; null when it keeps none for this reason.
- `last` (Number) How many backups the job keeps that are the most recent backups; null when it keeps none for this reason.
- `monthly` (Number) How many backups the job keeps that are the last backup of each of the most recent months; null when it keeps none for this reason.
- `weekly` (Number) How many backups the job keeps that are the last backup of each of the most recent weeks, which start on Monday; null when it keeps none for this reason.
- `yearly` (Number) How many backups the job keeps that are the last backup of each of the most recent years; null when it keeps none for this reason.
